about.note: P4 T2: what each tool on the tool wall stands for, as the published tags it is (resume.json projects.entries[].tags, the pills on /resume/ #projects). A tool's things are computed, never listed: every project crate whose published entry carries one of its tags, and Patchlamp's station if Patchlamp's entry does (src/content/tool-tags.ts; tests/unit/content/tool-tags.test.ts fails on a tag that is not in resume.json, or on anything that would light for a tool its entry does not name). Nothing here is shown: the tool's own words are its label tape (world.json tools).

truth.toy: A tool lifted off the wall makes everything on the bench built with it glow in the tool's colour: each project crate whose card names it, and the Patchlamp station if Patchlamp's does. A tool is also a part like any other (carried, thrown, painted, shipped): that claims nothing.
truth.real: Each project's entry on /resume/ #projects lists, as its tags, the technologies it was built with; each tool stands for the tags of one technology from /resume/ #skills (SQL for MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite; Laravel and Vue with or without their version).
truth.source: /resume/ #projects (each entry's tags) and #skills; src/content/tool-tags.json (the table, tested against resume.json: tests/unit/content/tool-tags.test.ts)

laravel.source: /resume/ #skills (Laravel); #projects tags "Laravel" and "Laravel 13" (the same framework, the second with its version)

vue.source: /resume/ #skills (Vue.js); #projects tags "Vue.js" and "Vue 3" (the same framework, the second with its version)

sql.source: /resume/ #skills (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite: no pill reads "SQL" alone; each is a SQL database); #projects tags of the same names. Not SQLAlchemy (an ORM for Python, not a database)
